Lewis Carroll, A Tangled Tale.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/lewis-carroll/a-tangled-tale

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Lewis Carroll, the author, died 1898 (Wikidata Q38082, P570 = 1898-01-14).

First publication of the text used: between 1880 and 1885. SE colophon: 'A Tangled Tale was published between 1880 and 1885 by Lewis Carroll.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in between 1880 and 1885, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement (quoted below) places it in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the work is in the public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, because the last person to die died in 1898 and life plus 100 years ended on 31 December 1998.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: A Tangled Tale was published between 1880 and 1885 by Lewis Carroll.
- Wikidata Q38082 (Lewis Carroll), P570 = 1898-01-14.
